messages:
Jamal Ortiz: Hey folks  just a quick one - my monitor arrived but shows "No Signal" and the dock seems to boot (white LED) but doesn't enumerate external displays. Laptop also won't charge from the dock. Anyone know who to tag?
Priya (IT): @Jamal Ortiz welcome! Can you confirm the dock model and the monitor input (HDMI/DP)? Also what's your laptop model? If you can try a direct cable from laptop->monitor that helps narrow if it's the dock.
Jamal Ortiz: Dock label: RWD-USB4-01 SN: 00921. Monitor is ASUS ProArt PA248QV using DisplayPort. Laptop: MacBook Pro 14 (M2 Pro). Tried a direct DP cable from laptop to monitor (same cable) and monitor wakes fine. So seems like dock isn't passing DP Alt Mode.
Priya (IT): Thanks - that suggests the dock firmware or PD passthrough. We'll create an RMA. Quick question: did the dock come with a small firmware sticker (QR) or a tiny USB-A cable? Sometimes a firmware flash via USB-A helps.
Jamal Ortiz: No QR, nothing. I'm remote (NY). Also small note: when I tried to connect to office Wi-Fi earlier my phone got the guest SSID prompt but my laptop didn't show corpwifi; is onboarding Wi-Fi cert needed?
Marco (Facilities): For remote folks we can ship parts. Priya, shall we swap the dock + 90W brick? Also Jamal, corpwifi certs are pushed via Okta VPN only after SSO; are you on the new-hire list in the IT portal?
Priya (IT): Opening ticket now. We'll overnight a replacement dock + 100W brick and include a USB-C->DP dongle. For corpwifi: IT pushes the corpwifi cert after you finish the device enrollment (Jamf/Intune). I see Jamal isn't marked as fully enrolled yet so I'll send the enrollment invite to your personal email.
onboard-bot: Ticket #83477 created by Priya (IT): "RMA RWD-USB4-01 - DP alt mode not passing, no charging"  assignee: Priya (IT)  ETA parts ship: 1 business day.
Jamal Ortiz: Thanks. Shipping address: 18 W 21st St, Apt 3A, New York, NY 10010. Please include a power-only USB-C cable if possible so I can charge while testing.
Priya (IT): Added power-only cable and DP dongle. Enrollment invite sent to jamal.ortiz@example.com for device enrollment; once you accept, corpwifi cert will be pushed. I'll update ticket with tracking.
Jamal Ortiz: Amazing, appreciate the quick turnaround! I'll test when the box arrives and report back. :v:
